curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can ancient folklore tricks and comical human disguises actually halt the march of modern bulldozers?
curatedMovie.description: When suburban sprawl threatens their home in the Tama Hills, native raccoons band together to fight back, mastering the ancient art of shape-shifting to blend into the human world.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Whimsical animated fantasy balanced by thoughtful ecological stakes, unfolding at an engaging, family-friendly pace.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Director Isao Takahata pairs playful shape-shifting comedy with a thoughtful environmental dilemma, making collective resistance both delightfully funny and heartfelt.
